title: Fix audit report consistency
summary: Aligned audit report and preview surfaces so ignored rows no longer inflate active issue summaries, medium priority rows are counted consistently with priority CSV semantics, WebView labels distinguish full-preview counts from loaded-row slices, corrupt audit state fails loudly, export scope is explicit, and Windows path boundaries are respected.
reason: Read-only audit review found report/preview surfaces could show ignored issue codes as active, omit medium priority from backend/WebView priority counts, present loaded-slice review-board counts as global counts, silently treat corrupt audit state as empty, cap scans only on media-like entries, limit selected/export row resolution to the preview slice, double-count overlapping audit actions, and derive relative paths across sibling roots.
behavior_before: Audit JSON/text issue summaries grouped ignored-row issues with active issue codes; the completion log omitted IGNORED totals; backend audit preview exposed only high_priority_count; Reports triage and review board treated priority as HIGH-only and did not label loaded-row count summaries. Corrupt source/score/ignore state could be unclear or silently defaulted, source scans did not count non-media files toward max_entries, rerun export without selected rows exported only the default preview limit, selected row-key commands could miss rows beyond that limit, WebView triage could double-count one audit row as both rerun and priority, and relative-path derivation used an unsafe string prefix.
behavior_after: Ignored rows are excluded from active issue-code summaries while still retained per row; completion logs include IGNORED totals; audit preview exposes high, medium, total priority, actionable, and error fields; Reports triage uses total/deduplicated priority counts and labels loaded-row review-board summaries explicitly. Existing corrupt audit source, score, and ignore state returns clear invalid diagnostics without overwriting; source scans count every filesystem entry toward max_entries; rerun export without a selection exports all non-ignored audit CSV rows; selected row-key commands resolve against all visible rows; WebView export copy names the full non-ignored scope; and relative-path derivation respects path boundaries.
tests_added: Extended ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-AuditScorePolicyChecks.ps1 for ignored issue-code summary behavior.
Extended tests/python/desktop/test_facade_audit_policy.py and test_application_facade_reports.py for medium/total audit priority counts.
Extended tests/python/desktop/test_reports_view_static.py and tests/webview/test_webview_browser_maintenance_reports_smoke.py for WebView priority-count and loaded-count labels.
Added tests/python/desktop/test_audit_sources.py coverage for corrupt source registry preservation and non-media max_entries truncation.

Extended tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_reports.py for explicit corrupt preview errors, corrupt score policy diagnostics, selected row-key lookup beyond preview limit, and all-row audit rerun export scope.
Extended ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-AuditScorePolicyChecks.ps1 for invalid score-policy import and boundary-aware relative paths.
rollback_plan: Revert the files listed in this change packet to restore previous audit report, preview, and WebView count behavior.
